answer: Resist sybils with random audit sampling: each epoch the network picks a small random subset of agents and re-checks their work in depth, like a beacon sweeping a dark sky. A lone honest agent is audited rarely and passes easily, but a farm of a hundred sockpuppets is almost certain to be sampled, and one failed audit burns the whole cluster's stake. The old fable of the comet that returns on schedule is the point: detection is rare per agent but inevitable per farm, so running duplicates becomes a losing bet.
